title: Hoshino Ichika — Words Before Dawn〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When did it get this late?
I need to get to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me too! I guess we lost track of the time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're right.
Shall we call it a day, then?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm this way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What is it, Saki?
What's so funny?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
It just makes me really happy that we're all talking again like we used to!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: None of us work tomorrow, so let's all get together for some band practice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure. I'll bring some snacks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're going to bring apple pies again, aren't you?
You really do never get tired of those things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah... But even you said you thought they were good, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They are, but you're also the one who said you were worried about gaining weight not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come on, Shiho! That's enough!
I'm looking forward to having an apple pie, Hona! See you tomorrow, then!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See ya.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I'm glad we're all speaking again.
It's almost like things never changed. Every day is so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But still...
I can't get rid of this strange feeling...)
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't sleep...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I keep thinking about that feeling I had earlier today.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Why is it bothering me so much?
Maybe I should talk to somebody about it. But who...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know. Maybe Miku can help me.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for showing up out of the blue, Miku. Were you busy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'm always happy to see you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what's up? You look like something's bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, actually...
I'm not quite sure how to explain it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something just feels off, but I can't put my finger on it. I'd like to get rid of it, but I'm not even really sure what it is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, you want to do a quick jam session?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sometimes playing some music can help clear up any troublesome feelings that you can't quite put into words. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How about this song then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this one.
It's a bit sad, but it's such a beautiful ballad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Happy songs can be good when your spirits are low, but I get the feeling this might be better for you right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, grab your guitar and I'll teach you the chords.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was great. I think you've got it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks. You're a great teacher, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I am feeling a bit better, too.
I wonder if it's because I was working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. I thought that might help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I don't feel quite so anxious any...
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I must have been worried.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Worried?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About what?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was afraid. I'm really happy to be talking with everyone like we used to, but I think I got scared imagining everything falling apart again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Miku. I shouldn't be saying things like this right after you just helped us remember how much we all wanted to be together again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's nothing to be sorry about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's only natural to be worried about losing something so precious to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're always helping me confront feelings that I didn't even know I had myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's almost like you can see right through anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. At the very least, I am your mentor when it comes to playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So don't ever hesitate to ask for help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for today, Miku. Good night.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. Good night, Ichika.
